ffmpeg-core.js / ffmpeg-core.wasm
@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 (single-thread build) from ffmpeg.wasm
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm

Corresponding source for this build: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v0.12.10
(npm package @ffmpeg/core@0.12.10).

GO Lens loads these files only when the browser cannot decode a selected video natively,
and runs them on the user's own device to convert that video to H.264 for analysis.
